search_scope: official H2-Stations API v2 documentation and data contract
NREL HITRF and H2FillS public programme pages
Cal State LA 2021 back-to-back article full-text channel inventory and DOI/custodian route

required: vehicle or receiving-vessel pressure and temperature
initial conditions, engineering units and reuse terms
controller, valve or ESD state channels sufficient to identify the station boundary
excluded_substitutes: availability, inventory or aggregate station-status APIs
laboratory traces without the station-control boundary
article figures or endpoint tables without machine-readable rows
facility descriptions without a rights-cleared raw archive

screened_sources.title: H2-Stations API v2
screened_sources.license_or_access: CC BY 4.0 documentation; personal bearer token required for API access
screened_sources.claim_limit: The public contract does not provide numeric process telemetry or a vehicle-side common-clock trace; it cannot support station-to-vehicle full-loop scoring.

screened_sources.title: H2Protocol/J2601 raw laboratory data route
screened_sources.license_or_access: Public download route described by the project; case-level reuse and channel-contract terms require verification before admission
observed_scope: vehicle-tank pressure and temperature laboratory traces
screened_sources.claim_limit: The locally retained H2Protocol material supports receiving-vessel component diagnostics, but it lacks the station controller/cascade/ESD contract required for the full-loop gate. It is not a new full-loop dataset.

screened_sources.title: Multi-year hydrogen refueling-station operation study
screened_sources.license_or_access: Published article; raw logger reuse terms and machine-readable archive not identified
observed_scope: station storage, delivery, compression and dispensing operation
screened_sources.claim_limit: The article is useful for operating-envelope and schema-request context, but publication-level summaries are not an independently scorable raw holdout.

screened_sources.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
screened_sources.license_or_access: Accepted manuscript and article are identifiable; operator logger reuse terms and a public machine-readable archive were not identified
observed_scope: real Cal State LA hydrogen research and fueling facility
per-fueling vehicle pressure and final pressure
vehicle tank temperature and ambient temperature
average fill rate and dispensed hydrogen amount
tank, hose, blowdown, booster and chiller command/valve states
per-second dynamic trend described by the article
screened_sources.station_controller_or_esd_channels: partial article-reported valve/command states; ESD and reuse attestation not public
screened_sources.claim_limit: The article is the strongest newly located station-to-vehicle acquisition lead, but article figures and the reported channel inventory are not a rights-cleared machine-readable holdout. Request de-identified rows and freeze them before scoring.

screened_sources.title: NREL HITRF/H2FillS fueling test programme
screened_sources.license_or_access: Facility and programme information public; raw synchronized logger export requires programme/custodian access
observed_scope: pressure, temperature and flow measurement roles
screened_sources.claim_limit: The programme and manual document a high-value measurement route and model-output channel schema, but H2FillS outputs are simulation results rather than a rights-cleared raw experimental logger archive. No reuse-cleared raw cohort with checksum, common-clock attestation and controller/ESD channels was publicly verified.

screened_sources.title: NREL H2FillS public validated simulator
screened_sources.license_or_access: Software registration and license; no raw measurement archive
screened_sources.claim_limit: H2FillS is a useful independent model and protocol reference, but its generated traces are not measured external holdout data and do not establish field safety.

screened_sources.title: ENDA HRS Connect hydrogen refuelling station monitoring
screened_sources.license_or_access: Real monitoring service description; public raw export and reuse terms not stated
screened_sources.claim_limit: The page confirms that real station telemetry exists and identifies a custodian lead, but it does not expose a reusable vehicle-side synchronized raw cohort.

screened_sources.title: Hydrogen refuelling station with integrated metal hydride compressor
screened_sources.license_or_access: Published article and figures; raw logger reuse terms not identified
observed_scope: 38 months of real medium-pressure station operation
automated valve and PLC sequence context
screened_sources.claim_limit: The article supports station architecture and operating-range context; figures and aggregate operation reports cannot close a machine-readable synchronized station-to-vehicle holdout.

required_delivery: channel dictionary, engineering units and calibration metadata
checksum and written permission for independent scoring
minimum_next_input.freeze_rule: Freeze the exact files, model version, split and scoring thresholds before opening numerical rows.

next_action: Send a privacy-safe custodian request for a minimum three-event schema pilot, then freeze a larger independent cohort only after role, unit, clock, checksum and reuse attestations are complete.
claim_boundary: This artifact records a current public-access recheck and exclusion decision. It adds no numerical validation, does not alter any frozen holdout or runtime parameter, and does not support an IJHE full-loop or field-safety claim.
